verdict.rationale: Metorial supplies the tool layer for autonomous agents rather than a native automation engine. Its sample apps describe bots that run on their own: a Slack standup bot that posts daily prompts and an interview coordinator that schedules automatically. These are developer-built apps on the SDK, so you write and host the runtime yourself. Magic Skills package repeatable workflows, and traces let teams review work after it runs, but nothing in the evidence shows built-in scheduling, triggers or background execution. Missing for 10: native scheduled or event-triggered automations, a managed background runtime for agent runs, a no-code way to set up an automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
